text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Is that...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
She looks busy... I wonder what
happened? I hope
she's not pushing
herself.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your advice, by the way!
Since
then, I've been collecting opinions
from a bunch
of friends!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This must be about that "game with no
winners or
losers" question. I didn't
really think through my
answer...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But once she explains, her motivations
all make
sense. She wants to get
Maruzensky to fully
immerse herself in a
game without worrying about
others.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to try out every single idea, so
give me
your honest opinion! First off...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Shadows exist everywhere, in every
generation.
Get my drift?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...A game of hide-and-seek on turf. This
game of
darkness has lasted through the
ages! Nothing is
impossible! You must
become the turf!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
How's this, Trainer? Think you can find
me?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Her head bobs in and out of sight.
Though she's
wearing a cloak that
blends in with the turf, it's
not enough to
camouflage her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Urk, I can't be the turf after all... One does not become the turf, one must run on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, a game's got to be thrilling, right?
A game
where the luckiest one wins
sounds fair to me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Do a one-draw game, no tricks. That
would really
heat things up!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: All right, it's your turn, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We play countless rounds of Old Maid
and
Doubt, even roping in other players
to join. But
Sakura Chiyono O is too easy
to read, and she
loses every game...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No waaay?! Everyone's way too good! I
guess the
king wears a tight mask!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I see. Then, how about a game where
you guess
tea variety?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You may guess wrong, but there's no
need to
declare a winner. I believe it
would make for a
wonderful experience.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'll have to remember the varieties
first! Learn
each one's taste and smell...

Okay, I'm good to go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O gulps down the tea,
doing her
best to remember the taste.
But she ingests far
too much, and...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I c-can't drink any more... I was going to
be the
best at this game too... Too much
tea will make
you have to go—Urp...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I think my stomach has settled
down. That
was almost a disaster...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's not so easy to find a game with no
winners or
losers. I guess playing on your
own would work,
but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Working with her strengths and
preferences could
be a good starting
point.
choice_data_list: What are you best at, Chiyono O?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
My strengths and preferences... I'm
pretty good
at karuta, proverbs, and...
Oh, my dad taught me
sumo stomping
and how to hold a teppo...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: No, not that teppo. It actually has to do with sumo...
choice_data_list: Gun, as in the festival shooting gallery?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Now let's see... Targets, festivals, and a
game
where everyone wins...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh! This might just work!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for the tip! I'll need
some
volunteers to help with all the
preparations, but
it's definitely doable!
I'll... make it happen!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Okay! This is gonna be great! Trainer, I'll invite you once everything's ready! It's time to Chiyono Go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like she has a plan on her hands.
Sakura
Chiyono O's eyes gleam with
excitement as she
pumps her fists in the
sky.
